body:
Here are the slides from my workshop on Organizing Religion for Festival of Homiletics yesterday. This is surely one of the most important gatherings of clergy in the country – thanks to all who put it together and especially to all who come with such a positive and gracious spirit.

 FoH Organizing Religion

 If you’re interested in what I’m doing to put this talk into practice, please check out

 https://www.convergenceleadership.org/

  

 I’d love to have you get involved!
